##### Project general facts

The Lana Residences, Dorchester Collection, Dubai is a truly exceptional address, conceived by the visionary architects Foster + Partners for OMNIYAT and managed with the legendary care of Dorchester Collection. Rising as a sculptural tower of flowing terraces and floor-to-ceiling glass, it holds a remarkably limited collection of only 39 private residences, so genuine privacy and exclusivity are assured for every owner. Homes range from gracious two and three-bedroom apartments with a study to magnificent four-bedroom residences, double-height living rooms and duplexes, crowned by six spectacular penthouses on the top three floors, each with its own private swimming pool and terrace.

Life here is enriched by a wonderful spectrum of leisure, beginning with an outdoor pool that looks out over a sparkling skyline and a fully equipped gym with dedicated yoga studios. There is also an elegant dining and function room with conference facilities and a welcoming lounge, while the building's interconnected design lets residents reach the adjoining hotel's celebrated restaurants, bars and luxury facilities discreetly through their own private entrance. An attentive team of concierge, doorman, porter, residences manager and car valet anticipates every need, with housekeeping, child care, laundry, maintenance, façade and pool cleaning, grocery deliveries, private trainers and in-residence dining all beautifully taken care of.

The interiors are the work of the celebrated French design duo Gilles et Boissier, who have used natural materials and pieces from their own furniture and lighting lines to unify the building, from the smallest detail to the striking marble entrance lobby. Spacious kitchens are appointed with Sub-Zero refrigerators and wine coolers, Gaggenau appliances and Quooker taps offering filtered, sparkling and boiling water on demand, while dressing rooms are by Molteni Dada and Poliform and the marble bathrooms feature modern tapware from THG Paris. Every residence is further enriched with seamless, intuitive technology, including wide-screen televisions by Bang & Olufsen, audio systems by Sonos and a fully customisable Crestron home automation system.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is one of Dubai’s most dynamic and fast-paced neighborhoods, known as the city's central business, commercial, and residential hub. Located just minutes from Downtown Dubai and the iconic Burj Khalifa, it offers a strategic location with seamless access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road. Business Bay is a prime destination for professionals, entrepreneurs, and investors looking to be at the heart of Dubai’s thriving economy, with a skyline defined by high-rise towers, luxury hotels, and modern office spaces.

Beyond its corporate appeal, Business Bay has evolved into a vibrant lifestyle destination. The area features a wide range of residential options, from upscale studios to spacious penthouses, many with stunning views of the Dubai Canal. Residents enjoy an urban lifestyle with access to fine dining, boutique cafes, waterfront promenades, gyms, and art spaces, all set against a backdrop of architectural elegance. The Dubai Water Canal also adds a touch of serenity, perfect for walks, boat rides, or simply enjoying the city lights by the water.

As one of the most well-connected and sought-after areas in Dubai, Business Bay continues to grow as a leading hub for luxury living and commercial innovation. Whether you're working, living, or investing, it offers the perfect blend of modern convenience, cosmopolitan energy, and high-end urban living — all in one prime location.
